data.name: Exterior Cleaning Services Melbourne | Prime Exteriors
data.description: The six things we do to the outside of a Melbourne property: pressure and surface cleaning, house washing, windows and gutters, stain removal, sealing, and builders cleans. Start from the problem, not the method.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to know which service I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and most people do not. Describe the surface and what it is doing, send a photo of the worst part, and we will tell you which of the six families it falls under and whether it needs one visit or two.

mainEntity.name: Can you do several surfaces in one visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is the normal way we work. A driveway is rarely the only thing that has gone off. Doing the paving, the glass and the gutters in the same visit costs less than three separate call outs, because the set up is only paid for once.

mainEntity.name: Is pressure cleaning safe on everything outside?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and this is the single most common cause of damage we are asked to repair. Render, painted weatherboard, soft timber, some tile glazes and anything with failing pointing will be marked by a pressure washer. Those surfaces get soft washed instead, where the cleaning is done by the solution and the pressure is barely above a garden hose.

Some things are permanent and it is fairer to say so at quote stage:

  • Etching in glass from long term mineral or construction deposit
  • Rust that has run through the full depth of light coloured aggregate
  • Tyre plasticiser that has migrated into porous concrete
  • Oil in a surface that has been sealed over the top of the stain

In each of those cases cleaning improves it, but the surface will not come back to new. Where that is the likely outcome we will do a test patch so you can see the realistic result before committing.

mainEntity.name: Do you work on commercial sites outside business hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and for most retail and hospitality sites it is the only sensible option. Car parks, loading areas and shopfront glazing get done when the site is quiet. Scheduling is agreed up front and repeated on a cycle rather than booked each time.

We are based in Dallas 3047 and work across Melbourne, with the heaviest coverage through the northern corridor and out to Sunbury. The service areas page lists the councils and suburbs with their own pages, and we quote outside that list as well.
